name: Bank Note
description: A magical piece of paper that legally forces your bank to hold more of your dirty money. Some say it's backed by the gold standard, but we know it's actually backed by internet memes. Good luck explaining this to the IRS.
usage_info: You can use this item to expand your max bank space.

name: Adventure Ticket
description: A crumpled piece of cardboard that supposedly guarantees you safe passage to a magical land. In reality, it just sends you on a borderline suicidal fetch quest. Don't forget to pack a snack.

name: Alcohol
description: Liquid courage in a suspiciously sticky bottle. It makes your jokes seem funnier and your bank account seem larger. Please don't try to operate heavy machinery or send risky texts while under the influence.

name: Apple
description: A perfectly average red fruit that doctors absolutely despise. Throwing this at a medical professional deals 10 points of psychic damage. It's crunchy, nutritious, and incredibly boring.

name: Padlock
description: A heavy chunk of metal designed to keep greasy pickpockets away from your hard-earned cash. It's surprisingly effective against digital thieves. Just don't lose the key, or you'll be locked out of your own life savings.

name: Laptop
description: A battered computing machine completely covered in anime stickers and Cheeto dust. It's primarily used for rendering low-quality memes and arguing with strangers on Reddit. The fan sounds like a Boeing 747 taking off.

name: Fishing Pole
description: A sturdy wooden stick with a string attached, designed for violently ripping sea creatures from their homes. It smells faintly of desperation and old bait. Your grandpa would be so proud of you.

name: Hunting Rifle
description: A terrifyingly loud tube of metal used for securing your own dinner in the wild. It kicks like a mule and requires ear protection unless you want permanent tinnitus. Point the noisy end away from yourself.

name: Beggars Bowl
description: A severely chipped ceramic bowl that smells vaguely of pennies and regret. Holding this immediately drops your dignity level to zero. However, it forces strangers to feel profound pity for you.

name: Ancient Coin
description: A heavily tarnished piece of currency from a society that probably collapsed due to hyperinflation. Historians would literally kill you to put this in a museum. Instead, you're going to hoard it like a goblin.

name: Trash
description: A smelly, compressed cube of literal garbage that nobody wants. Some people claim one man's trash is another man's treasure, but those people are clinically insane. This is just disgusting.

name: Lucky Horseshoe
description: A rusted piece of iron that was forcefully removed from a horse's foot for your gambling benefit. Keeping this in your pocket statistically prevents you from losing your entire life savings at the casino. Probably.

name: Shovel
description: A heavy-duty digging tool perfect for uncovering buried treasure or hiding the evidence of your terrible financial decisions. It gives you massive blisters, but the potential payout is totally worth the physical trauma. Get digging.

name: Mouse
description: A plastic peripheral that has suffered through thousands of enraged clicks during sweaty gaming sessions. The sensor is slightly broken, but it still works. Do not throw it against the wall.

name: Keyboard
description: A ridiculously loud mechanical board that annoys everyone within a 5-mile radius. It's covered in gamer gunk and missing the escape key. Your typing speed will increase, but your social life will plummet.

name: Camera
description: A high-tech digital lens used to capture incredibly embarrassing moments in crisp 4K resolution. It flash-bangs anyone looking directly at it. Perfect for blackmailing your wealthy friends.

name: Pizza
description: A greasy, lukewarm circle of dough topped with questionable meats and excessive cheese. Eating this instantly cures depression and replenishes your vital energy. It is the cornerstone of a gamer's balanced diet.

name: Diamond
description: An obnoxiously shiny rock that societal norms dictate is worth a fortune. It's hard enough to scratch glass and shiny enough to blind a medieval peasant. Keep it locked up before someone yoinks it.

name: Rare Pepe
description: A legendary image macro that hasn't seen the light of day since 2014. It is completely immune to screenshotting and retains its value through sheer meme magic. Treat it with the utmost respect.

name: Dank Box
description: A highly suspicious cardboard box radiating intense internet energy. Opening this might grant you unfathomable riches, or it might just Rickroll you. You won't know until you tear off the tape.

name: Work Box
description: A plain, depressing box awarded to wageslaves who actually clock in on time. It smells like stale coffee and broken dreams. Inside lies the true reward for submitting to capitalism.

name: Meme Box
description: A poorly packaged crate stuffed to the brim with outdated reaction images. It guarantees a mild chuckle and decent loot. Just don't let the irony poison your mind.

name: Exclusive Gems Box
description: An obnoxiously luxurious chest dripping in digital diamonds and gold trim. Only the elite upper echelon of society even knows this exists. Opening it will instantly make your poorer friends resent you.

name: Corn Seeds
description: A handful of yellow kernels that will eventually grow into the most boring vegetable on earth. Farming this requires patience, dirt, and water. It's honest work for a dishonest person.

name: Carrot Seeds
description: Tiny orange specks that will magically transform into food for rabbits. If you grow enough of these, your eyesight might improve slightly. It's basically an agricultural cheat code.

name: Broccoli Seeds
description: The starting point for the vegetable that every child universally despises. It grows into a tiny, edible tree that tastes strictly like health and sadness. Your mom would be thrilled you bought these.

name: Worm
description: A slimy, wriggling tube of meat that lives in the dirt. It is utterly disgusting to hold, but fish absolutely love the taste. Hook it and cast it into the abyss.

name: Ant
description: A tiny, insignificant insect that works harder in a day than you do in a year. It can lift 50 times its body weight, making you look pathetic by comparison. Please don't step on it.

name: Ladybug
description: A delightfully spotted little beetle that culturally guarantees good fortune. If it lands on you, your luck stat secretly increases for five minutes. It is the only acceptable bug to find in your house.

name: Stickbug
description: A master of disguise that will completely ruin your day if it starts dancing. Finding this guarantees that you just got stickbugged in real life. It's a living meme.

name: Spider
description: An eight-legged terror that causes grown adults to squeal in pure panic. It weaves sticky traps to capture its prey, much like how mobile games capture your wallet. Keep it away from your face.

name: Fossil
description: The calcified remains of a creature that died millions of years before the internet was invented. It is unimaginably old and incredibly fragile. A museum curator is rapidly approaching your location.

name: Gold Nugget
description: A heavy, irregularly shaped chunk of pure wealth ripped straight from the earth. Prospectors would have murdered you for this back in 1849. Today, you can just sell it to a bot.

name: Rabbit
description: A fluffy, twitchy-nosed mammal that multiplies faster than a crypto scam. It runs at the speed of light but is no match for a well-aimed hunting rifle. Sorry, little guy.

name: Duck
description: An incredibly loud, aquatic bird that refuses to share its bread. It spends its days floating on ponds and judging humans from afar. Quack.

name: Deer
description: A majestic woodland creature that has a terrible habit of jumping directly into headlights. It provides excellent meat if you can actually land a shot. Just watch out for the antlers.

name: Boar
description: An aggressive, hairy tank of a pig that will absolutely charge you if you look at it wrong. It has massive tusks and zero chill. Approach with extreme caution.

name: Skunk
description: A small woodland creature armed with a biological weapon of mass destruction. If you spook it, your social life will be ruined for at least two weeks. Shoot from a very safe distance.

name: Fox
description: A sneaky, orange trickster that causes chaos in local chicken coops. It is far too clever for its own good and laughs at your attempts to catch it. You finally got one.

name: Bear
description: A colossal mountain of muscle and fur that could snap you in half like a twig. Engaging this beast in combat was a terrible life choice, but you survived. Enjoy your massive payout.

name: Wolf
description: A fierce, pack-hunting apex predator that absolutely commands the wilderness. It howls at the moon and strikes fear into the hearts of noobs. You are legally a badass for hunting this.

name: Tiger
description: A massive, striped murder-cat that completely dominates the jungle. It is incredibly rare, extremely dangerous, and highly illegal to hunt in real life. Good thing this is just a Discord bot.

name: Dragon
description: A literal fire-breathing myth that shouldn't even exist in the game's ecosystem. Defeating this required god-tier RNG and a blatant disregard for your own safety. You are a true legend.

name: Common Fish
description: The most incredibly boring and average fish to ever swim in the ocean. It tastes like nothing and sells for pennies. At least it didn't steal your bait.

name: Tropical Fish
description: A vibrant, beautifully colored swimmer that belongs in an expensive dentist's office aquarium. It is completely useless for eating but looks fantastic. A solid catch.

name: Blowfish
description: A highly toxic, balloon-shaped fish covered in lethal spikes. Touching it incorrectly will send you straight to the hospital. Handle it with extremely thick gloves.

name: Squid
description: A squishy, tentacled sea creature that defends itself by squirting blinding ink in your face. It looks like an alien and tastes amazing when fried. A very decent catch.

name: Octopus
description: An impossibly intelligent invertebrate with eight arms and zero bones. It can probably solve puzzles faster than you can. You should feel slightly guilty for catching it.

name: Crab
description: A heavily armored sea-spider wielding two pinching weapons of pain. It walks completely sideways and refuses to cooperate. Watch your fingers, or you'll lose a chunk of flesh.

name: Lobster
description: An underwater bug that rich people decided was a luxury dining experience. It is bright red and incredibly stubborn to catch. Serve with melted butter for maximum profit.

name: Shrimp
description: A microscopic crustacean that is basically the popcorn of the ocean. It is barely a snack on its own, but it fries up nicely. You caught the literal bottom of the food chain.

name: Shark
description: A terrifying apex predator filled to the brim with razor-sharp teeth. Pulling this into your boat was a monumentally stupid, yet highly profitable decision. You survived, somehow.

name: Whale
description: A gargantuan mammal that makes your tiny fishing boat look like a bath toy. How you physically reeled this in with a standard pole is a mystery to modern science. Absolute unit.

name: Kraken
description: An apocalyptic horror from the deepest abyss of the ocean. It has sunk entire armadas, but you somehow caught it with a worm. You have peaked in life.

name: Trivia Trophy
description: A shiny plastic cup proving that you have an unnecessary amount of useless knowledge memorized. It asserts your intellectual dominance over your clearly inferior friends. Nerd.

name: Candy
description: A generically sweet lump of sugar packed with artificial flavoring and food dye. Eating this instantly rots your teeth but gives you a mild sugar rush. Dentists hate this one simple trick.

name: Candy Corn
description: A waxy, triangular crime against humanity masquerading as a festive treat. Half the population loves it, and the other half thinks it tastes like sweetened candle wax. Make your choice.

name: Scary Mask
description: A cheap, plastic Halloween mask guaranteed to mildly frighten small children. Wearing it gives you a sense of edgy anonymity. It smells overwhelmingly like artificial rubber inside.

name: Spooky Mask
description: A slightly more terrifying version of a cheap Halloween mask. It features fake blood and an uncomfortable breathing hole. It is perfect for ruining someone's peaceful evening.

name: Voodoo Doll
description: A highly cursed fabric doll stuffed with dark magic and petty revenge. Poking this with a needle will objectively ruin your enemy's day. Use with extreme caution and malice.

name: Jacky o' Lanty
description: A carved pumpkin that has miraculously achieved sentience. It glows with an eerie inner fire and constantly judges your life choices. Do not look directly into its glowing eyes.

name: Life Saver
description: A magical red flotation device that literally rejects the concept of your death. Having this in your inventory tells the grim reaper to politely back off. It is the ultimate safety net.

name: Jar of Singularity
description: A tightly sealed mason jar containing a microscopic black hole. It constantly threatens to consume the entire universe if the glass shatters. Please be incredibly careful when carrying this.

name: Skin Fragments
description: A violently disgusting pile of flaky, dead skin cells collected from lord knows where. Nobody wants to look at this, let alone touch it. Why is this even in the game?

name: Cookie
description: A freshly baked circle of dough packed with melting chocolate chips. It is scientifically impossible to be sad while consuming this. Just remember to clear your browser history.

name: Chill Pill
description: A highly potent pharmaceutical designed to stop you from raging at a video game. Swallowing this forces your blood pressure to normalize. Take it when the internet gets too toxic.

name: Energy Drink
description: A radioactive-looking liquid packed with enough caffeine to stop a heart. Chugging this grants you the ability to perceive time in slow motion. Warning: crash imminent.

name: Garbage
description: A festering pile of useless refuse that emits an incredibly foul odor. It holds absolutely zero value and takes up precious inventory space. Throw it away immediately.

name: Duct Tape
description: A sticky roll of silver magic that repairs broken objects, broken relationships, and shattered dreams. If it moves and shouldn't, apply this heavily. The ultimate tool of a redneck engineer.

name: Pepe Ring
description: An exquisitely crafted band of gold inscribed with ancient frog runes. It grants the wearer immense clout and unchecked meme authority. Precious, indeed.

name: Corncob
description: A rigid cylinder covered in starchy yellow kernels. It is equally useful as a depressing meal or a makeshift bludgeoning tool. Welcome to the cornfields, buddy.

name: ZomB's Zombee
description: A rotting, undead insect that buzzes with a terrifying, aggressive intent. It craves brains instead of pollen. Keep it strictly inside its jar.

name: Engagement Ring
description: An absurdly expensive piece of jewelry designed to trap someone into a lifelong contract. Buying this mathematically ruins your net worth. Hope they say yes.

name: Holy Water
description: A blessed flask of water that burns demons on contact. Throwing this at a Discord mod is highly effective. It smells faintly of incense and divine justice.

name: Aetheryx' Flower
description: A stunningly beautiful botanical specimen that only blooms in the darkest corners of the internet. Smelling it fills your head with lo-fi beats. It is exceedingly rare.

name: Blob Pet
description: A squishy, gelatinous orb that bounces around with zero thoughts in its metaphorical head. It is incredibly cute and entirely useless in combat. Give it a gentle squish.

name: Pepe Trophy
description: A towering monument of solid gold shaped like a legendary green frog. It is the ultimate symbol of wealth and chronically online behavior. Flex it on the peasants.

name: Pepe Medal
description: A heavy golden medallion that proves you are marginally better than average at internet games. It clinks loudly when you walk, alerting everyone to your superiority. Wear it with pride.

name: Jack O' Lantern Pet
description: A floating, fiery gourd that happily follows you around in the dark. It occasionally spits tiny embers and demands candy. It's the spooky companion you never knew you needed.

name: Jacky O'Lantern
description: A standard, non-sentient carved pumpkin that rots significantly faster than you'd expect. It smells like autumn and decaying organic matter. Put a candle in it.

name: God Box
description: An impossibly heavy crate radiating an aura of blinding, divine light. Opening this box might fundamentally alter your account's existence. The developers explicitly warned you about this.

name: Alien Blaster
description: A sleek, chrome weapon that aggressively goes 'pew pew' when the trigger is pulled. Firing this backward will instantly disintegrate your own torso. Do not look down the barrel.

name: Half-Eaten Burger
description: A lukewarm, soggy fast-food burger with a massive bite taken out of it. Eating it is a true test of your immune system's capabilities. Desperate times call for desperate measures.
usage_info: Restores a tiny bit of health, or gives you food poisoning.

name: Ban Hammer
description: A massive, heavy mallet wielded exclusively by unpaid internet janitors. Striking a user with this instantly vaporizes their account from the server. The power trip is intoxicating.
usage_info: Swinging it makes you feel powerful.

name: NFT Receipt
description: A depressing piece of digital paper proving you spent your rent money on a cartoon monkey. It serves as a permanent reminder of your terrible financial literacy. Utterly worthless.

name: Golden Chalupa
description: A mythical, deep-fried taco shell radiating grease and unimaginable power. Legend states that consuming this grants you immortality, or just violent diarrhea. It is a fast-food holy grail.

name: Used Bathwater
description: A small jar of cloudy, murky water purchased from a desperate internet personality. It smells distinctly of regret and cheap soap. Only a true simp would value this.

name: Backrooms Carpet
description: A damp, foul-smelling swatch of yellow carpet ripped from a terrifying alternate dimension. It hums aggressively when you hold it to your ear. Keep it far away from your bedroom.

name: Soundboard
description: A chaotic technological device pre-loaded with copyright-infringing music and ear-shattering airhorns. Spamming its buttons will guarantee you get muted in any voice channel. Pure auditory terrorism.

name: Haunted Mannequin
description: A terrifying plastic retail prop that definitely shifts positions when you blink. Keeping it in your inventory causes your character to suffer intense paranoia. Burn it with fire.

name: Waffle Iron
description: A heavy-duty kitchen appliance that presses batter into delicious grid patterns. It can also be wielded as a shockingly effective blunt weapon in a pinch. Serve with syrup and violence.

name: Mystery Box
description: A highly questionable cardboard package purchased anonymously off the dark web. It could contain life-changing riches, or just a pipe bomb. The suspense is literally killing you.

name: Reddit Gold
description: A completely meaningless digital medal awarded to you by a stranger who liked your mediocre pun. It gives you a brief hit of dopamine before you realize it has no real-world value. Thanks, kind stranger.

name: Arcade Tickets
description: A massive, tangled roll of paper stubs won by aggressively cheating at Skee-Ball. They can be exchanged for exactly one plastic spider ring at the prize counter. Capitalism at its finest.

name: Flat-Pack Furniture
description: A heavy cardboard box containing wooden planks and 400 identically confusing screws. Attempting to build this without crying is a monumental test of human endurance. Good luck with step 4.
usage_info: Requires a Ph.D. in Swedish engineering to build.

name: Signed Poster
description: A glossy piece of paper autographed by an incredibly obscure anime voice actor. Hanging this on your wall acts as a highly effective repellent against romantic partners. A true weeb artifact.

name: Lizard Scales
description: A handful of dry, shedding scales collected from the floor of a prominent tech CEO's office. They serve as definitive proof of the reptilian overlord conspiracy. Hide them from the FBI.

name: Union Card
description: A small, laminated piece of paper that causes billionaires to wake up screaming in a cold sweat. Presenting this to your boss grants you a magical aura of workers' rights. Solidarity forever.

name: Kitten Ears
description: A highly embarrassing piece of headwear that immediately ruins your digital reputation. Wearing this makes Discord moderators highly attracted to your profile. Meow for the camera.

name: VIP Badge
description: A shiny, digital flex proving you consistently empty your bank account for a streamer who doesn't know you. It allows you to post custom emotes in a chat moving too fast to read. Congratulations, whale.
usage_info: A flex of your disposable income.

name: Rug Pull Coin
description: A totally worthless cryptocurrency token left over from a project that suddenly 'got hacked.' The developers bought a yacht, and you got left holding the bag. A brutal lesson in finance.

name: Gallon of Milk
description: The legendary dairy product your father supposedly went to the store to buy 15 years ago. It is completely unspoiled and radiates a fatherly aura. The prodigal son returns.

name: Clip Button
description: A powerful digital tool used to permanently immortalize a streamer completely embarrassing themselves. Pressing it at the right time guarantees you thousands of upvotes. Capture the cringe.

name: Suspicious Rock
description: A weirdly warm, glowing stone handed to you by an aggressive local crackhead. It might be a valuable mineral, or it might just be highly radioactive. Keep it away from your groin.

name: Glitched Code
description: A chaotic snippet of raw syntax that fundamentally breaks the laws of reality when executed. Speedrunners would sacrifice their firstborn child just to hold this. Do not inject it into the mainframe.

name: Ring Light
description: A circular LED contraption essential for aspiring TikTok influencers dancing in their bedrooms. It aggressively highlights your face and drains your self-respect. Perfect lighting for terrible content.

name: Max Level Waifu
description: An exceptionally rare JPEG of an anime girl that someone spent three months' rent to acquire. She will never love you back, but her stats are incredible. The pinnacle of degenerate hoarding.

name: Neon Pet
description: A blocky, aggressively glowing digital animal highly coveted by terrifying 9-year-olds on Roblox. It serves as a blatant status symbol in a virtual playground. Do not trade it for a sandwich.

name: Sigma Grindset Audio
description: A heavy cassette tape containing 10 uninterrupted hours of deep-bass phonk music. Listening to it forces you to ignore your friends and focus purely on financial gain. Stay completely toxic.

name: Troll Mask
description: A vintage, wrinkled plastic mask featuring a heavily outdated internet meme face. Strapping it on gives you a sudden urge to ask people if they are mad. Problem, officer?

name: Viral Freakout Video
description: An incredibly shaky, vertical cell phone recording of a Karen completely losing her mind over expired coupons. It is pure, unadulterated internet gold. Monetize the misery.
